notes: #1’s Commons title says ‘in spiegelbeeld’ but its cartouche is at upper right like the 1575 vol. 2 plate (#2, #5); the mirrored 1572 vol. 1 plate (#4) has it at upper left, so dated 1575. #9’s 1646–84 is the Rijksmuseum’s range for Gerrit van Battem. #7 is a ground plan; #10 (1726) photographed in the open book, kept #9 for P2.
